The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.30402/2023 registered for offences punishable under Section 498A of the IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Heard Smt. Pooja M. Koorse, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri. B.N. Jagadeesha,
learned NC: 2024:KHC:44804 Addl.SPP appearing for respondent No.1 and have perused the material on record.
3.
During the pendency of these proceedings, it transpires that the parties to the lis have entered into a settlement and have placed on record such settlement along with the joint affidavit.

Terms of settlement reads as follows:
"JOINT AFFIDAVIT We, (1) Akshay R. S/o Rajesh M.S., aged about 29 years,
residing at No.10, 2nd Cross, Soundhamini Layout, Konankunte, Bengaluru- 560102;
(2) Rajesh M.S., S/o Late T.N. Subbarao, aged about 59 years, residing at No.157, 1st Main Road, Jayalakshmipuram, Mysuru- 570012; (3) Vani R. W/o Rajesh M.S., ages about 50 years, residing at No.157, 1st Main Road, Jayalakshmipuram,
Mysuru-570012; today at Bangalore the Petitioners in -2 the above matter and the Respondent No.2 namely Ms. Karishma Rao D/o Late Ramesh Rao K.K., aged about Sri Akshya R vs State Of Karnataka on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168590312/
2 29 years, residing at 510, 4th Floor, Peace Rhythm Apartment, Ullal Junction,
Jnanaganganagar, Bengaluru 560056; do hereby solemnly affirm and state as follows:
1. I, the Respondent No.2 hereinabove state that on 25.09.2023, I have lodged a Complaint against the Petitioners and the same was registered by the Respondent No.1 vide Crime No.416/2023, for which the charge sheet was also filed by the First Respondent Police upon which the Hon'ble II Addl. ACMM Judge, Bangalore;
by its impugned order dated 29.11.2023 in C.C.No.30402/2023 took cognizance of the offences punishable under offences punishable under Sections 498-A R/w Section 3 and 4 of Indian Penal Code, 1860; and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961; against the Petitioner hereinabove.
NC: 2024:KHC:44804 2.

We, the Petitioner No.1 and the Respondent No.2 herein, state that the dispute in question has been settled / compromised between us in M.C.No.314/2024 before the Bangalore Mediation Centre on 09.09.2024.
3.

In the settlement agreement in MC 314/2024 the Petitioner No.1 and the Respondent No.2 have agreed that they would co-operate with each other to amicably settle and close all the legal disputes pending them.
In the light of the said settlement Respondent no.2 does not wish to pursue this matter and is cooperating in closing the above matter.
4. We state that the compromise between the Respondent No.2 and the Petitioner no.1 has been arrived with their free consent, without any threat or coercion or undue influence.

5. 1, Smt. Karishma Rao i.e., the Respondent No.2 hereinabove state that in the light of the settlement between Petitioner no.1 and me, I am not desirous of pursuing the matter arising out of my Complaint dated 25.09.2023 registered by the Respondent No.1 police vide Crime No.416/2023,
for which the charge sheet was filed upon which the Hon'ble II Addl. ACMM Judge, Bangalore; by its impugned order dated 29.11.2023 in C.C.No.30402/2023 took cognizance for the offences punishable under Sections 498-A r/w Section 3 and 4 of Indian Penal Code, 1860; and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961; against the Petitioners hereinabove for which the present petition is filed seeking quashing of the same.

6. I, the Respondent No.2 hereinabove state that now the dispute between me and the Petitioners is resolved and compromised as per settlement arrived at in MC 314/2024 before the Bangalore Mediation Center and I therefore do not wish to pursue any further proceedings against the Petitioners.

WHEREFORE, we humbly pray before this Hon'ble Court to quash the Complaint dated 25.09.2023 registered by the Respondent No.1 police vide Crime No.416/2023, Charge sheet filed upon which Sri Akshya R vs State Of Karnataka on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168590312/
